title: pbiplint configuration
description: Rules on or off, severity overrides, and the fail threshold. Saved as pbiplint.config.json next to the project or anywhere above it.

rules.description: Rule id to "off", to a severity that replaces the rule's own, or to an object with a severity and the rule's options. Ids match regardless of case.

oneOf.description: A severity override and the options the rule declares (see its page).

failOn.description: Lowest severity that makes the command line exit 1.
